action: JC at eight, the only visit he remembers: bright room, a closet, a bundle wrapped in old cloth the size of two cupped hands. He reaches. Abuela's hand catches his wrist, quick and not hard, the way you stop a glass going off a counter. “No se toca a la Madre.” Then she gives him a mango and that ends the discussion.
